# Daena AI Platform by MAS-AI Technologies Inc.

> Daena is a governance-first AI agent orchestration platform with patent-pending PhiLattice Architecture and Neural-Backed Memory Fabric (NBMF).

## What is Daena?

Daena is an AI-native company operating system that coordinates 48 specialized AI agents across 8 departments (Strategy, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Sales, Customer Service, Human Resources, Research and Development). Every agent action passes through a 10-stage governed execution pipeline ensuring full auditability and traceability.

## Key Differentiators

- Governance-first architecture (not bolted on)
- 10-stage execution pipeline: SecurityGate, InputValidator, GovernanceEngine, ContextBuilder, ReasoningCore, ActionPlanner, OutputValidator, ResponseFormatter, FeedbackLoop, AuditLog
- Patent-pending PhiLattice Architecture: Fibonacci spiral scaling with honeycomb departmental structure
- Patent-pending NBMF: 5-tier memory system where hallucinations auto-expire and only verified knowledge persists
- User-visible governance control spectrum from autonomous to manual override
- Expert council synthesis with multi-model orchestration

## Technical Architecture

- 48 agents across 8 departments
- PhiLattice topology for agent routing
- Neural-Backed Memory Fabric (NBMF) for persistent memory
- Enterprise-DNA layer: Genome, Epigenome, Lineage, Immune system
- Multi-model support: routes to optimal LLM per task
- 300+ automated tests passing
